seq_moe_device_io_off.note: Lane neural-io-2. Default ON (waste removal): MoEBlock's forward on resident sequence tensors (x, y, logits, picks, weights stay on the device; 2 x 4 T D bytes over PCIe and four host zero-filled outputs per call removed; host-array entry outputs np.empty). The OFF arm leaves moe_forward_dev out of the binding, so MoEBlock.to_device returns host arrays and the host-array entry runs (the before arm). Same moe_forward_core launches on the same words: no bit moves. A/B owed on moe plus a neighboring shape (e.g. T=6144, D=1024, F=2816; T=8192, D=768).

idn_emb_scan_deferred_off.note: Lane neural-io-2. Default ON (IDENTICAL; waste removal): the resident backward of a fresh gradient queues the dY non-finite scan and its partials' copy before the fold and reads them after the call's one final wait (one host round trip per call removed); a hit raises the same message from the same word (the fold never writes dY). A carried dW keeps the eager scans. No bit moves. A/B owed on embedding plus a neighboring shape (V=50,257, T=65,536).

xcnn_res_new_nozero_off.note: Lane neural-io-2. Default ON (waste removal): BatchNorm2d/1d and Dropout2d resident outputs (y, dx) are not +0.0 filled; every word is stored by bn_apply / the dx pass / the dropout apply / the mask product. No bit moves. A/B owed on batchnorm2d and dropout2d plus a neighboring shape (e.g. 32 x 128 x 28 x 28).

xcnn_res_free_async_off.note: Lane neural-io-2. Default ON (waste removal): res_free returns an array to the reuse pool without waiting for the queue (its next user is queued behind every earlier use on the one in-order context); the wait stays where the array is destroyed. No bit moves. Touches every x_cnn resident tensor (conv, pool, BasicBlock, GCN/SAGE, BatchNorm, Dropout); A/B owed on batchnorm2d, dropout2d, conv2d, resnet-block.

idn_af_vec_fused.note: Lane neural-io-2. Default OFF (new kernels, fold-bearing): the IDENTICAL Adafactor vector step of more than AF_NORM_BLOCK values as vfuse (op_af_vec cells + p's and u's block partials, coop_sumsq chains) + vfin (both ascending partial folds on two warps, the alpha and denom tails) + the apply: 6 launches -> 3, no one-thread launch, 9n -> 8n words. Same chains in the same order: bits expected unchanged against the OFF arm (ID check on nv + amd decides; build the host twin with the same define).

neural:batchnorm2d.route: BatchNorm2d.forward/backward(DeviceTensor) -> batchnorm_forward_m / batchnorm_backward_m; outputs from res_alloc_nofill; frees via res_free

neural:dropout2d.route: Dropout2d.forward/backward(DeviceTensor) -> dropout2d_m / map2_m; outputs from res_alloc_nofill; frees via res_free
